title: Introducing World App 3.0: A super app for humans
notes: First-party announcement establishing the World App 3.0 Vault introduction.

title: Morpho Mini App for World App brings DeFi lending, borrowing and rewards to 25 million users
notes: First-party announcement documenting Morpho-powered lending, borrowing and vault rewards in World App on World Chain.

title: How do I use Earn?
notes: Current first-party product documentation states that Earn supports assets including WLD, USDC, wETH and wBTC and uses Morpho to identify on-chain lending rates; regional availability and withdrawal liquidity can vary.

title: What is a Dollar Vault?
notes: First-party documentation states that Earn replaced the USDC Dollar Vault and that the legacy Dollar Vault converted USDC into sDAI, with yield linked to the Sky Protocol Dai Savings Rate.

title: What is Worldcoin Vault?
notes: First-party documentation states that Earn replaced the WLD and USDC Vaults and describes the legacy-balance migration choices. It does not establish that the WLD Vault used Sky/sDAI.

title: Introducing World Money: a financial super app for humans
notes: First-party launch announcement establishes World Money as the current money/wallet surface and identifies Morpho among the financial features available through the app, while noting that features and eligibility vary by country.
